summary.en: Kogoro and Conan walk past Beika Park and see Megure, Takagi, and Chiba along with witnesses on a canvassed area. They decide to look further into it. After returning from the bar, Eiji was struck by a metal pipe in the park and died instantly. After their father's death, Eiji was believed to abuse his mother and Yuichi was probably the protector. After interrogating Takase, the police get a call from officers stationed at the Kadowakis. When they arrive, the house was burned completely and Yasuko's dead body had already been brought by forensics. Yuichi was found uninjured.
